issues.problem: Value スリッパ (slippers) gave odd scenes with 出かけました / 帰りました / 歩きました (going out in slippers).
issues.action: Replaced with 下駄[げた] / geta, natural with every ending.

issues.problem: English 'came in <item>' reads as 'entered' (e.g. 'Mr. Tanaka came in black boots').
issues.action: Changed English of 来[き]ました to 'came wearing'.

issues.problem: テレビゲーム: 'ゲームを遊ぶ' is common modern usage, so distractor 遊[あそ]びません is not plainly wrong for that value.
issues.action: Replaced with バドミントン / badminton.
